sampleQuery: Query raised by TPA on pre-authorisation request PA-2026-55120 (Kamala Sharma): 1) Please submit the first consultation papers and the duration of the present ailment (gallbladder stones). 2) Please provide the ultrasound report supporting the diagnosis. 3) Please provide a revised cost estimate with room category. Pre-authorisation will be processed on receipt of the above.

steps.label: Checking why the insurer asks: pre-existing disease rules (page 9 · Clause 4.3)
Finding where each document comes from
Checking the reply makes no promises

help.plainMeaning: The insurer has not rejected the cashless request. It is on hold until you send three things: proof of when the gallbladder problem started, the ultrasound report, and an updated cost estimate showing the room type. They ask about the start date to check whether this is a pre-existing disease still in its waiting period.
help.urgency: Reply today. Until the insurer gets these papers, the hospital may ask you for a cash deposit.

documents.name: First consultation papers (OPD notes or prescription)
documents.source: The doctor or clinic Kamala first visited for stomach pain

documents.name: Ultrasound report
documents.source: Hospital radiology department (or the earlier diagnostic centre)

documents.name: Revised cost estimate with room category
documents.why: The insurer checks it against your ₹5,000/day room limit

help.draftReply:
To: TPA / Insurance desk
Re: Query on pre-authorisation PA-2026-55120 – Kamala Sharma

Please find attached:
1. First consultation papers dated [date], showing the ailment started on [date].
2. Ultrasound report dated [date] confirming gallbladder stones.
3. Revised cost estimate from City Care Hospital, with room category [room type, ₹ per day].

Kindly process the pre-authorisation request.

Shubham Sharma (son of the patient)
Phone: [your phone number]
help.timelineNote: Insurers in India have time limits for cashless decisions once all documents are received. Ask the TPA desk for the time limit that applies and keep a note of when you submitted the papers.

citations.quote: Expenses related to pre-existing diseases are covered after 36 months of continuous coverage from the first policy commencement date.
Room, boarding and nursing expenses are payable up to 1% of the Sum Insured per day for a normal room and up to 2% of the Sum Insured per day for ICU.
